## Description

Briefly describe the purpose of this change and the problem or capability it addresses.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: A code change that improves performance
- [ ] `refactor`: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation only changes
- [ ] `test`: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
- [ ] `chore`: Changes to build process, tooling, or dependencies

## Conventional Commit & Semver Impact

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Appropriate semver label attached if needed (`semver:major`, `semver:minor`, `semver:patch`, or `semver:skip`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code compiles cleanly with zero TypeScript errors (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Code passes all linting and Prettier formatting checks (`npm run format:check` and `npm run lint`)
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass with high coverage (`npm run test:coverage`)
- [ ] Documentation updated in `README.md` and/or `docs/mcp-schema.md` if applicable
